about.text: Hard cheese produced in the Dinaric mountain region made from a combination of cow’s and goat’s milk.

sources.text: Sirana Gligora (Pag), created 2009/2010 from surplus goat milk plus cow milk, pasteurised. Producer lists standard at 4 months+, extra-mature at 6 months+
